era.title: PRE-HISTORIC
era.blurb: Fire, hunt, taboo, the circle at night.

commands.name: DEMAND THE HUNT TRIBUTE
commands.text: Half the kill to the fire. The young go hungry first.

commands.name: ENFORCE THE FIRE TABOO
commands.text: No one tends the flame but the chosen. Cold is the price of order.

commands.name: NAME THE OUTCAST
commands.text: One voice is cut from the circle so the rest may sleep.

commands.name: SHARE THE FEAST
commands.text: Bellies full tonight. Tomorrow's debt is not spoken.

closing.synthesis: The circle and the wanderer agreed on where the fire sits.
closing.no_synthesis: The fire burned on. The circle quietly split.
